texts.preamble: Manoj vs The Commissioner on 10 April, 2023 Author: V.M.Velumani Bench: V.M.Velumani W.P.No.10890 of 2 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated: 10.04.2023 Coram: The Honourable Ms.Justice V.M.Velumani and The Honourable Mr.Justice V.Lakshminarayanan W.P.No.10890 of 2023 and W.M.P.No.10795 of 2023 Manoj, Proprietor Pita Poc, Having principal place of business at, 12/25, Al Baith Royal, Nallanna Street, Royapettah, Chennai 600 014. .. Petitioner Vs. 1.The Commissioner, Greater Chennai Corporation, Ripon Building, Chennai 600 003. 2.The Chairperson / Executive Engineer, Township Vending Committee Zone Xiii, Corporation of Chennai, Chennai 600 020. .. Respondent Prayer: Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitutio India, praying for issuance of a Writ of Mandamus, forbearing the Respondents from interfering with the running of the petitioner's f https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 1/6 Manoj vs The Commissioner on 10 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180804375/ 1 W.P.No.108 truck Pita Poc near Besant Nagar, Chennai Corporation Ward No.176 Chennai 600 090, wherein we specialize in serving Ice creams and Popsicle therein till the Petitioner-s representation dated 03.02.2 considered and decided as per the provisions of the Street Vendors (Protection of Livelihood Regulation) Act, 2014 by the Respondents. For Petitioner : Mr.M.Karpagam For Respondents : Ms.P.T.Ramadevi Standing Counsel Order
texts.facts: The petitioner has come out with the present Writ Petition forbearing the respondents from interfering with running of the petitioner's food truck Pita Poc near Besant Nagar, Chennai Corporation Ward No.176, Chennai 600 090, wherein Ice creams and Popsicle are served therein, till his representation dated 03.02.2023 is considered and decided as per the provisions of the Street Vendors (Protection of Livelihood Regulation) Act, 2014, by the respondents. 4.According to petitioner, he is running a mobile vending business in the name and style of Pita Poc from the year 2022, by obtaining necessary license from the Food Safety and Standard Authority of India with registration No.22421551000171. Further, he also registered his business under the Goods and Service Tax Act in GST No.33CKOPM2828QIZQ and obtained Trade Mark for the brand name PITA POC under Trade Mark Registration No.4925837. The officials of the respondents visited the food truck of the petitioner several times and threatened to seize his food truck stating that the petitioner must obtain Street Vending ID Card and apply to the Town Vending Committee for 'Certificate of Vending'. Therefore, when the petitioner approached the 2nd respondent for the same, the 2nd respondent informed him orally that enumeration process of collecting details like names of vendors, nature of vending, area / place of vending was handed over to https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis private agencies by the Corporation of Chennai. The State of Tamil Nadu recently formed the Street Vending Committee to regulate street vendors in Chennai and the 2nd respondent is the Chairperson for the said committee for Zone XIII. Hence, the Manoj vs The Commissioner on 10 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180804375/ 2 petitioner sent representation dated 03.02.2023 to the respondents for issuing ID Card and to issue certificate of vending to continue food truck business. Since, no order has been passed on the said representation dated 03.02.2023, the petitioner has come out with the present Writ Petition. 5.From the above materials, it is seen that the petitioner has approached the respondents for issue of Street Vendor ID and Certificate of Vending. The respondents have not considered the application of the petitioner.
